sourceAnchors.message: Assigning an Object to null is a code smell.  Consider refactoring.
sourceAnchors.reason: Deliberate mutation of a fixture-owned enum values array proves the next values call returns independent contents. The null element is observed only by the fixture and is never passed to production.
